verdict.rationale: DeepInfra documents self-serve, pay-as-you-go per-token billing with no minimums or contracts. It also refers to each model having a 'standard per-token price', which implies per-model token pricing without a sales conversation. However, no evidence shows a public price list or that prices are published for every hosted model. Missing for 10: a published per-model price table, evidence of coverage across the whole catalog (including image, speech and embedding models), and independent confirmation that prices are visible without signing up or contacting sales.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see public per-token prices for every hosted model without talking to sales

citations.quote: You only pay per token — no idle GPU time, no minimums, no seat fees.
Flex inference is billed at a 20% discount off the model's standard per-token price.
Low pay-as-you-go pricing - no long-term contracts, no hidden fees, no surprises.
